scripts.compact: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); fs.rmSync('src/managed', {recursive: true, force: true}); fs.mkdirSync('src/managed', {recursive: true}); const files = fs.readdirSync('src').filter(f => f.endsWith('.compact')); if(files.length > 0) { const name = files[0].replace('.compact', ''); require('child_process').execSync(`compactc src/${name}.compact src/managed/${name}`, {stdio: 'inherit'}); }"
scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true});" && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('src/managed', 'dist/managed', {recursive: true}); fs.readdirSync('src').filter(f => f.endsWith('.compact')).forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(`src/${f}`, `dist/${f}`));"
scripts.dev: npm run compact && npm run build
